name: Junior Barons
description: The Junior Barons were a racially mixed street gang — mostly White, with Latino and Black members — that emerged at the Julia C. Lathrop Homes on Chicago's north side in the 1960s. They formed when younger members of the Blackhawk Hoyne Outlaws began associating with the Barons and became their junior faction. The gang controlled Lathrop Homes as a turf gang, including minor drug sales, until the early 1970s when the Insane Deuces displaced them.
